system.description: The item placed on the ground channels mountain heat over 1 m² for 3 hours. The Thuul chooses the temperature within ±10 degrees. The GM places and tracks this fixed area; it does not follow the bearer or emit light.
system.summary: Can warm or cool the ground around a runic object for an extended time.
